CustomField.label: Base URL
CustomField.description: Veleiro API base path. Leave blank to use the default callout:Veleiro_API/api/v1, which routes through the Veleiro_API Named Credential. The Veleiro environment (host) is set on that Named Credential, not here.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave this blank (or callout:Veleiro_API/api/v1). It uses the Veleiro_API Named Credential — the Veleiro environment is controlled there, not in this field. Only change if Veleiro tells you to.
